record.original_question: If p1, ..., pℓ are integer-valued generalized polynomials and T1, ..., Tℓ are commuting measure preserving transformations on a common system, must the averages (1/N) Σ T1^{p1(n)} f1 · ... · Tℓ^{pℓ(n)} fℓ always converge in L2?

evidence.quote: Problem 14. Let p1, . . . , pℓ be integer valued generalized polynomials. Show that the averages 1/N Σ T1^p1(n) f1 · · · Tℓ^pℓ(n) fℓ converge in the mean as N → ∞.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu)$ be a probability space and let $T_1,\dots,T_\ell\colon X\to X$ be commuting invertible measure-preserving transformations. A generalized polynomial $p\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\mathbb{Z}$ is any integer-valued function obtained from the identity function and integer constants by finitely many applications of addition, multiplication, and the floor function $\lfloor\,\cdot\,\rfloor$ (so e.g. $p(n)=\lfloor\alpha n^2\rfloor\lfloor\beta n\rfloor + \lfloor\gamma n\rfloor^3$ is allowed). 

Given integer-valued generalized polynomials $p_1,\dots,p_\ell$ and bounded measurable functions $f_1,\dots,f_\ell\in L^\infty(X,\mu)$, prove or disprove that the multiple ergodic averages
$$A_N(f_1,\dots,f_\ell) \;=\; \frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N} (T_1^{p_1(n)}f_1)(x)\cdots (T_\ell^{p_\ell(n)}f_\ell)(x)$$
converge in $L^2(X,\mu)$ as $N\to\infty$.
artifact.category_tag: multiple ergodic averages along generalized polynomials
artifact.status_search_result: For ordinary integer polynomial iterates, Walsh (Annals 2012) proved L^2 convergence of multiple ergodic averages even for nilpotent groups of transformations, which subsumes the commuting polynomial case. However, generalized polynomials involve the floor function and are not polynomial maps, so Walsh's theorem does not apply. Recent results (Frantzikinakis–Kuca, and work on Hardy field functions) handle special subclasses, but no general L^2 convergence theorem for arbitrary generalized polynomial iterates with several commuting transformations appears in the literature; the question seems to remain open in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Norm convergence of nilpotent ergodic averages
status_evidence.snippet: Walsh proves L^2 convergence of multiple polynomial ergodic averages for nilpotent (in particular commuting) groups of measure-preserving transformations.
status_evidence.claim: Polynomial-iterate case (without floor functions) is solved by Walsh.

status_evidence.title: Walsh's ergodic theorem, metastability, and external Cauchy convergence
status_evidence.snippet: Walsh showed multiple polynomial ergodic averages arising from nilpotent groups of measure preserving transformations always converge in the L^2 norm.
status_evidence.claim: Polynomial (not generalized polynomial) version is settled.

status_evidence.title: Multiple ergodic averages along functions from a Hardy field
status_evidence.snippet: Convergence results for averages along Hardy field functions including some involving floor functions, under specific conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Only special subclasses of generalized polynomial iterates have been handled; the general statement appears open.
